zh: 同一行里如果选了较小的数却没选更大的数，换成更大的不会违反行上限，总和只增不减。
所以每行只需保留最大的 factor[i] 个数作为候选；候选集的任何子集都满足各行上限，问题变成在候选中选最大的 x 个。
逐行排序取前 factor[i] 大加入候选；候选数不足 x 就输出 -1；否则将候选降序排序取前 x 个求和（x=0 时为 0）。和可达 10^15，用 64 位整数。
en: If a row takes a smaller number while leaving a larger one, swapping to the larger one keeps the row limit and never lowers the total.
So each row only needs its factor[i] largest numbers as candidates; any subset of the candidates respects every row limit, and the task becomes picking the x largest candidates.

Sort each row and add its top factor[i] values to the candidates; if there are fewer than x candidates, output -1; otherwise sort the candidates in descending order and sum the first x (0 when x=0). The sum can reach 10^15, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Keep only the factor[i] largest elements of each row, then take the x largest among all candidates.

## Proof of correctness

If some row selects a smaller element without selecting a larger one, swapping them keeps the row count unchanged and does not decrease the total. Therefore some optimal solution uses only the top factor[i] items of each row. The candidate set already respects every row's limit, so any subset of it is valid, and choosing the global x largest is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n² log(n²)), space O(n²).
